name: Share prompt
summary: Share pill with a paper-plane icon that gets tapped; the plane flies off leaving a dotted trail.

params.name: clickAt
params.note: frame of the tap, after at

params.name: color
params.note: pill colour; default the style's accent

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at
